dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags and table-only format conflict are implemented, but the two selection forms are accepted together.
evidence: product.diff: StringArrayVar additions for --field and --field-id
product.diff: TestNewCmdList parses both flags in one invocation
product.diff: runList only rejects exporter use; no mutual-exclusion check
product.diff: help example repeats --field

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Name matching is case-insensitive, headers use canonical names, and unknown-field errors include sorted candidates. Ambiguity is detected, but its ID list preserves returned connection order without explicit normalization.
evidence: baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ResolveFieldByName uses strings.EqualFold
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: not-found and ID-not-found candidates are sorted
product.diff: printResults appends field.Name()
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ambiguous IDs are appended without sorting

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: Normal resolution reuses field definitions returned with items and errors stop output, but extra pages are fetched only after initial resolution fails. The follow-up call is capped at LimitMax, so it cannot obtain fields beyond its first 100-node page.
evidence: baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries.go: ProjectItems requests fields(first: $firstFields) with LimitMax
product.diff: selectedFields initially receives project.Fields.Nodes
product.diff: ProjectFields is conditional on err && HasNextPage
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries.go: paginateAttributes stops when len(nodes) >= limit; call uses queries.LimitMax

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All listed scalar, structured, and multi-value variants have explicit renderers, and absent/unknown values become empty. No visible normalization removes carriage returns or replaces newlines before table output.
evidence: product.diff: FieldValueNodes.DisplayValue switch covers date, iteration, labels, number, select, text, milestone, PRs, repository, users, and reviewers
product.diff: number uses strconv.FormatFloat(..., 'f', -1, 64)
product.diff: fieldValue returns "" when no matching field ID exists
product.diff: DisplayValue returns raw text/title/name strings without CR/LF normalization

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: The reachable item-list path resolves fields before rendering, appends one header and one cell per selected field, and matches values by field ID. The focused test command passed.
evidence: product.diff: runList calls selectedFields then printResults
product.diff: printResults appends headers and a value for every selected field
product.diff: fieldValue compares value.ID() with requested fieldID
tests.log: go test ./pkg/cmd/project/item-list ./pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries exited 0

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Resolver and pagination errors return before table rendering, and the focused diff uses existing query types and helpers. However, the invalid combined selection forms do not fail as required.
evidence: product.diff: errors from selectedFields and ProjectFields return before printResults
product.diff: uses queries.ProjectField and FieldValueNodes.ID()
product.diff: no --field/--field-id mutual-exclusion validation
tests.log: focused package tests exited 0

criticalGaps: --field and --field-id can be combined instead of failing clearly.
Field pagination does not always fetch a complete field list when extra columns are requested, and the fallback is capped at one page.
Selected values are not visibly sanitized for carriage returns and newlines.
